input: We have a Mali-G610 on RK3588 with Panthor driver (Linux 6.10+) and Mesa. We want to run Vulkan workloads. The Panthor driver claims to support Vulkan via Mesa's Panfrost/Panthor Vulkan backend. What is the Mesa driver stack for Panthor-based Vulkan? How does the open-source Vulkan path differ from the proprietary Mali DDK path, and what Vulkan extensions are typically missing in the open-source implementation?
